claims.text: The Foundation has a route for requests of £100,000 and above.
The process begins with an Expression of Interest form submitted through the Grants Management Portal.
Applicants will receive bespoke guidance within 10 working days after submitting the Expression of Interest.
If a request is potentially suitable, a call will follow the Expression of Interest.
The Expression of Interest is for major grants of £1 million or more.
The grants can cover core, capital, or project costs.

For capital or project costs, the organisation's income need not exceed £1 million.
